changelog:
- Initial release of the "专利分析支撑立项报告生成 Agent" skill for generating data-driven project proposal reports based on patent analysis.
- Automatically identifies user intent for project proposals and executes a full workflow: technology scope definition, search strategy, seven-module analysis, and final report output.
- Integrates PatSnap patent data to support all analytical conclusions with real patent data; prohibits empty descriptions and any mention of costs.
- Comprehensive modules include: research status & competition, enterprise positioning, innovation assessment, IP strategy, technical route, FTO risk, and evaluation metrics.
- Provides clear workflows, search execution guidelines, and report output templates for standardized, actionable reports.
summary: 专利分析支撑立项报告生成 Agent——用户明确说项目立项时触发，自动执行「技术领域界定→检索策略→7大模块分析（竞争格局/企业定位/创新论证/知产布局/技术路线/FTO风险/考核指标）→整合输出完整立项报告」全流程，融合 PatSnap 智慧芽专利数据，生成数据驱动的科研项目立项报告。
